{{Quote|Our biggest, most stacked slider! Piled high with two patties, triple cheese, deep-fried Tapani triangles, mega-leaf lettuce, a slice of algae-bread, Boontaspiced mustard, plankton spread, larded neutrinos and a fried blubberbird egg, with a green jumbolive on top, it's just the thing to satisfy a Herglic-sized hunger.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Giju slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Algae-bread''' was a type of [[Bread/Legends|bread]] found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] included a slice of algae-bread in the [[giju slider]]s he sold at his [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], located on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The ''Lords of the Expanse Sector Guide'' notes that the campaign setting begins in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> algae-bread was served at the [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] [[Vor-cal Feast]] held on the [[House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[moon]] [[Vilhon]].<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" />

==Behind the scenes==
Algae-bread was first mentioned in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', a supplement for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Chris Doyle]], and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" />
